title: Find a Majority Element
question: Find a value occurring more than half the time, or -1.
code:
nums = list(map(int, input().split()))
candidate, count = None, 0
for value in nums:
    if count == 0: candidate = value
    count += 1 if value == candidate else -1
print(candidate if candidate is not None and nums.count(candidate) > len(nums) // 2 else -1)
explanation: Boyer-Moore finds a candidate, then a count verifies it.
